initial.title: APK Provenance Locker — Verify APK restore evidence
initial.main:
LOCAL APK VERIFICATION

Verify APKs before restoring

For Android users keeping APK files, this checks each app, version, signing history, and SHA-256 file fingerprint before a reinstall.

Try it with sample data
Open two sample APK records.
Verify an APK
Verified on this device
Password-encrypted exports
No sign-in or account
Your APK files are never uploaded.

YOUR VERIFIED APK RECORDS

Keep verified APK evidence
Verify an APK
Export restore kit
⌁
No APK evidence yet

Verified APKs will appear here. Choose a file to check its signature, package name, and version.

Verify your first APK
How the locker verifies evidence
Choose an APK.
The locker checks Android's v1, v2, and v3 signatures and creates a SHA-256 file fingerprint on this device.
Read the package and version.
It reads the package name and version from the APK.
Check signer and downgrade risks.
Verified signing history and version codes reveal new certificates and incompatible downgrade risk.

OPTIONAL ONE-TIME PURCHASE

Group APKs by device

Locker Plus costs $12 once. It adds private device labels for sorting a large locker. Verification, signer and downgrade warnings, and restore-kit export stay free.

The free locker is active.

APK checks run on this device using Android's signature rules. Android still makes the final install decision.
